sky arts.title: Tales Of The Unexpected

sky cinema premiere.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema premiere.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema premiere.title: One Last Shot
sky cinema premiere.desc: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defence network.

sky cinema premiere.title: The Deb
sky cinema premiere.desc: Two teenage cousins dig deep to find self-acceptance and a date to the Debutante Ball in a small country town in Australia.

sky cinema premiere.title: Better Man
sky cinema premiere.desc: The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams.

sky cinema action.desc: Stylish historical epic retelling the fierce battle at Thermopylae in 481BC. The Spartan king, Leonidas, and his tiny army of 300 followers provided inspiration for the whole of Greece as they fought the massed ranks of the Persian army whose commander, King Xerxes, had up to a million warriors at his disposal.

sky cinema action.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
sky cinema action.desc: Greek Gen. Themistocles leads the charge to fight invading Persian forces led by the god Xerxes -- once a mortal -- and Artemisia.

sky cinema action.title: Kong: Skull Island
sky cinema action.desc: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers encounter the mighty Kong and other monstrous creatures after travelling to an uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean.

sky cinema action.title: Spider-Man 3
sky cinema action.desc: Life is sweet for Peter Parker, MJ loves him, her career is taking off and Spidey-mania is sweeping New York. However, when an alien parasite bonds to his suit, it's not long before the good times and Spidey turn bad. While his ugly ego is taking centre stage, MJ is dumped from her Broadway show, Harry remembers Spider-Man's role in his father's death, and Peter is consumed by revenge.

sky cinema family.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
sky cinema family.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of Kitty Galore who dreams of global domination.

sky cinema family.title: A Minecraft Movie
sky cinema family.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

sky cinema family.title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
sky cinema family.desc: Kermit and company try to take their variety show to Broadway, while Miss Piggy grows jealous of a friendly waitress.

sky cinema comedy.title: Instant Family
sky cinema comedy.desc: When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

sky cinema comedy.title: Grimsby
sky cinema comedy.desc: Wrongfully accused and on the run, a top MI6 agent joins forces with his dimwitted brother to save the world from a sinister plot.

sky cinema comedy.title: American Pie: The Wedding
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jim and Michelle are getting married and Jim struggles to win over his future in-laws and deal with his embarrassing dad. Meanwhile, Stifler isn't invited to the ceremony, but he's determined not to be left out.

sky cinema comedy.title: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
sky cinema comedy.desc: A champion NASCAR driver's cosy position alongside his best friend at the top of the championship is threatened by a flamboyant French newcomer. With his confidence shattered, the driver draws on the help of his father and some eccentric training techniques to claw his way back to the top.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Pacific Rim
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A washed-up ex-pilot and an untested trainee must drive an old, obsolete robot in a last-ditch effort to repel a lethal force of monstrous invaders.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Constantine
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book `Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Pet Sematary
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Dr. Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbour Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: When the Federation receives a distress signal from planet Vulcan during a hearing to decide whether Kirk has cheated on his final test at the academy, his friend Dr McCoy sneaks him aboard the USS Enterprise as it sets out on its maiden voyage.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Heretic
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Two young missionaries become ensnared in a deadly game of cat and mouse when they knock on the door of the diabolical Mr. Reed. Trapped in his home, they must turn to their faith if they want to make it out alive.

sky cinema thriller.title: Drop
sky cinema thriller.desc: Violet is a widowed mother who goes to a restaurant to meet Henry, her charming and handsome date. However, she soon receives phone messages from a mysterious, hooded figure who threatens to kill her young son and sister unless she kills Henry.

sky cinema thriller.title: Juror #2
sky cinema thriller.desc: A juror for a high-profile murder trial finds himself struggling with a serious moral dilemma that could influence the verdict and potentially convict, or free, the accused killer.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws
sky cinema thriller.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

sky cinema thriller.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema thriller.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema thriller.title: Red Dragon
sky cinema thriller.desc: Thriller adapted from Thomas Harris's first Hannibal Lecter novel about an FBI profiler called out of retirement to help catch a serial killer nicknamed the Tooth Fairy. The agent has the uncanny ability to project himself into the minds of his criminal prey, but the case forces him to confront his past and consult his former nemesis - the now-incarcerated Dr Hannibal Lecter.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
sky cinema greats.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
sky cinema greats.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart and they want peace with the Federation. Hiowever, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.

sky cinema greats.title: The Lost Boys
sky cinema greats.desc: Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires.

sky cinema greats.title: Batman Forever
sky cinema greats.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?

sky cinema drama.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
sky cinema drama.desc: Singer Freddie Mercury defies stereotypes and convention to become one of history's most beloved entertainers. After leaving Queen to pursue a solo career, Mercury reunites with the band for one of the greatest performances in rock 'n' roll history.

sky cinema drama.title: Tow
sky cinema drama.desc: The true story of Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman who fought her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a tow bill for $21,634.

sky cinema drama.title: Chicago
sky cinema drama.desc: Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

sky cinema drama.title: The Friend
sky cinema drama.desc: Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past.
